scope.method: copy source, delete __schedule_barrier(), check with fn.py across flag variants and honest source constructs

classes.name: function-pointer-dispatch
classes.construct: Replace the inlined member call with an explicit function-pointer local: `void (*fp)(Npc*,s32,s32) = *(void(**)(Npc*,s32,s32))((char*)(*(void**)q) + 0xac); fp(q, q->m854, -1);`. The named function pointer forces the compiler to load the vtable pointer and slot pointer into locals, producing the target's exact load/call ordering without the barrier.
classes.evidence: 0060BD64_fp.cpp matches 48/48 words with 0 IDENTITY MISMATCH; verified on all 51 family addresses 0060BD64..0063A748.

classes.name: struct-copy
classes.construct: Copy the struct to a named local, modify the field, copy back: `Req24 tmp = r; tmp.m18 = 1; r = tmp;`. The struct copy forces the store order and the r0 constant allocation that the barrier enforced.

classes.name: pointer-local-store-order
classes.construct: Take a pointer local to the store destination before storing: `u8* g8=&gate8; u8* g9=&gate9; *g8=a; *g9=b;` (002D455C) and `undefined4* p40=(undefined4*)(param_1+0x40); *p40=0;` (002FE86C). The named address cannot be reordered past the following load/store, replacing the barrier's scheduling effect.
classes.evidence: 002D455C_b.cpp matches 71/71 words; 002FE86C_b.c matches 43/43 words; both 0 MISMATCH.

classes.name: barrier-redundant-default-flags
classes.construct: Simply delete __schedule_barrier(). The barrier was unnecessary: the source compiles to the target's bytes without it under the original default flags.
classes.evidence: All 10 re-checked with their recorded flags and matched 100%: 0024F0D4, 002ABDE8, 003248BC, 0038862C, 003B7480, 003BDDE8, 003C1384, 0040E1BC, 004139B0, 004D0804.

classes.name: optimization-level-flags
classes.construct: Delete __schedule_barrier() and build with the optimization flags the original used. The barrier was compensating for -O3 -Otime over-scheduling; -O2, -O2 -Otime, -O3 without -Otime, or -Ono_tailcall produce the target's instruction order naturally.
classes.evidence: All 37 re-checked and matched 100% with their winning flag set (O2time 21, O2 15, notail 1).
